name: mustard
soil: Sandy loam to loam, pH 6.5–8.0; tolerates slightly saline soil but not waterlogging

stages.name: Germination / Emergence
stages.irrigation: Sow in good moisture after a pre-sowing irrigation. The first irrigation is due only at 30–35 days.
stages.fertilizer: Basal (irrigated): 35 kg urea + 100 kg single super phosphate (SSP) + 25 kg MOP per acre. SSP also gives the sulphur mustard needs.
watch_for: Painted bug and sawfly on young seedlings
tips: Seed rate 1.5–2 kg per acre; rows 30–45 cm apart; sow 2–3 cm deep
Thin plants to 10–15 cm apart at 15–20 days

stages.name: Vegetative / Branching
stages.description: Leaves form a rosette, then branches grow.
stages.fertilizer: Second half of urea: 35 kg per acre with the first irrigation.

stages.name: Flowering
stages.description: Yellow flowers open. Aphids build up now in cool, cloudy weather.
stages.irrigation: Irrigate lightly if the soil is dry; avoid heavy watering in windy weather (lodging).
watch_for: Mustard aphid colonies on flower tips
Alternaria blight — dark round spots with rings
tips: Spray for aphids when about 10% of plants have colonies on the tips
Spray in the afternoon, when bees are less active

stages.name: Pod Formation / Pod Filling
stages.irrigation: One irrigation at pod filling if the soil is dry — the irrigation that matters most for yield.
watch_for: Stem rot — cottony white growth on stems, plants dry
tips: For aphids spray Dimethoate 30 EC 400 ml per acre in 100–125 litres of water
A light irrigation protects the crop on frosty nights

stages.name: Maturity / Harvest
stages.description: Pods turn yellow-brown and seeds change colour.
watch_for: Pods shattering if harvest is late
tips: Harvest when 75% of pods are yellow-brown, in the early morning to reduce shattering
Dry the crop on a clean floor before threshing

common_pests.name: Mustard aphid
common_pests.symptoms: Pale green insects in dense colonies on tips, flowers and pods; plants stunted
common_pests.control: Dimethoate 30 EC 400 ml per acre in 100–125 litres of water

common_pests.name: Painted bug
common_pests.symptoms: Black-and-orange bugs sucking young seedlings, which wilt
common_pests.control: An irrigation at 3–4 weeks reduces it; spray only if many seedlings wilt

common_pests.name: Sawfly
common_pests.symptoms: Dark green-black larvae eat leaves full of holes
common_pests.control: Irrigation drowns larvae in the soil; shake plants in the morning and destroy fallen larvae

common_diseases.name: White rust
common_diseases.symptoms: White raised spots under leaves; swollen, twisted flower heads
common_diseases.control: Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre at the first sign; repeat after 15 days

common_diseases.name: Alternaria blight
common_diseases.symptoms: Dark brown round spots with rings on leaves and pods

common_diseases.name: Stem rot (Sclerotinia)
common_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked patches on the stem, cottony white growth, black seed-like bodies inside
common_diseases.control: Carbendazim 50 WP 1 g/litre at 45–50 days in problem fields; deep summer ploughing; crop rotation
